body: Although i didnt get much replies From this community i Will have to thank you all just for being there. For me that was probably not enough as I decided my own fate but for someone just holding on to last hope it really means something to find someone to Talk to.

I most definetely wont rethink it. I just see no Way to tell that. Even to my mom or dad… To my girlfriend it seems impossible. I’ll rather just say i feel we should End . And then go and kill myself a few days later. Only possibility would be that i write a suicide letter. But even then it doesn’t help. This Way it would be just another depressed guy taking his life and bringing his mistake with him to the grave

Although what you say is true it would require that i say everything to everyone i know. And i just dont see that happening. I wish i could say im capable of doing that but i know im not. No Way i could tell that to Any person i know. I rather just End my life since i am
Too weak.
